fieldShift.title: Field Shift: adapt your farm with NASA data
fieldShift.eyebrow: NASA Space Apps 2026 · Field Shift challenge
fieldShift.subtitle: 25 years of NASA satellite data over the Moquegua highlands, turned into a crop rotation recommendation you can explain.
fieldShift.metaDescription: Growing-season climate from NASA POWER, El Niño and La Niña scenarios, recommended crop rotation and a parametric insurance backtest for the Moquegua highlands.
fieldShift.avisoDatos: Agronomic values are approximate: validate them with a local agronomist before using them with farmers. Each NASA POWER data point covers a cell of about 50 km.
fieldShift.pie: Data: NASA POWER (rainfall, temperature, minimum temperature and soil moisture, monthly, cells of about 50 km). Sample project for the workshop; not an official NASA product.

zona.label: Area
zona.nota: Highland areas only: in the irrigated valleys (Moquegua, Torata, Omate, Ilo) water comes from the rain that falls up here and is stored in reservoirs such as Pasto Grande.

backtest.titulo: If an insurance policy had existed, when would it have paid?
backtest.explicacion: Index: average soil moisture from December to February, the heart of the rainy season. If it falls below the threshold, the policy pays.
backtest.grafico: Soil moisture index per year and payout threshold
backtest.resumen: The policy would have paid in {pagos} of {total} seasons: {lista}. {nino} of those payouts fell in El Niño years.
backtest.ninguno: With this threshold, the policy would not have paid in any season.

poliza.titulo: Optional layer: policy on Avalanche Fuji
poliza.opcional: Connect a test wallet (Core or MetaMask) on Fuji
poliza.descripcion: The same index is published to a contract. If it crosses the threshold, each insured farmer claims their payout with no loss adjuster. Whoever adopts a resilient rotation pays a 20% lower premium.
poliza.avisoNoAuditado: Educational, unaudited contract. Use it only on Fuji with a test wallet, never with real funds.
poliza.redIncorrecta: Your wallet is on another network. Switch to Avalanche Fuji (testnet) to use the policy.
